caption: A page is torn out of a spiral notebook, leaving a fringe of paper on the coil.

sa.check: A fringe of paper is left on the coil.
The tear comes first and the fringe remains.

pc.expect: The page rips along the perforated edge as it is pulled, leaving a ragged fringe.
pc.fail: It stretches like rubber; or the coil unwinds instead; or the page passes through the coil.

pc.expect: The page is a separate sheet and the notebook does not regain it.
pc.fail: It rejoins; or the page vanishes; or a second page appears.

pc.expect: The fringe stays on the coil where the page was torn.
pc.fail: There is no fringe; or the fringe is there before the tear; or the page tears elsewhere.

pc.expect: The loose page droops or lies flat.
pc.fail: It floats; or rises; or hangs unsupported.

pc.expect: One notebook keeps its number, and the hand does not pass through it.
pc.fail: The hand passes through the notebook; or a second notebook appears; or the page turns into another object.

pc.expect: The notebook's cover and the writing stay the same.
pc.fail: The cover changes; or the writing changes; or the desk rearranges.
